about: PD-49: the public keys that sign lesson-content approvals (the API's LESSON_APPROVALS_SIGNING_KEY; plan F.3). An approvals file is accepted only when signed by one of these keys -- CI verifies every signature (scripts/lessons/verify-approvals.mjs) and the lessons engine refuses an unknown key id. Each entry: {id, publicKey, env, addedAt, retiredAt?, revokedAt?, note?}. publicKey is the base64 SPKI DER of an Ed25519 key; id is the first 16 hex of the SHA-256 of that DER. env is 'production' or 'staging': only a production key's approvals reach children. retiredAt: no new approvals after it (CI refuses a changed file it signs); what it signed before stays valid, so a key is NEVER removed. revokedAt: nothing it ever signed is accepted. A key is added in its own PR, never with approvals (CI refuses both together); changes here need the owner's review (CODEOWNERS). Empty until the owner generates the first key.
